objective: Deliver full-page decorative background replacement for an existing static portfolio: replace the hero-only SideRays effect with one continuous Plasma backdrop, keep the effect visible while scrolling through the whole portfolio, support dark and light themes, respect reduced-motion preferences and page visibility, retain responsive mobile and desktop presentation

deliveryProfile.firstRunnableSlice: A local responsive page with real positioning, one representative project, navigation, and contact path; placeholders are allowed for non-blocking content gaps

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Deliver and verify replace the hero-only SideRays effect with one continuous Plasma backdrop
Deliver and verify keep the effect visible while scrolling through the whole portfolio
Deliver and verify support dark and light themes
Deliver and verify respect reduced-motion preferences and page visibility
Deliver and verify retain responsive mobile and desktop presentation

phases.purpose: Confirm only blocking scope, constraints, risk, and approval boundaries within the batched intake budget
phases.exitEvidence: A validated ProjectBrief, measurable acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions for non-blocking gaps

phases.purpose: Measure current behavior before changing it
phases.exitEvidence: Baseline checks, scores, or artifacts are recorded

phases.purpose: Choose the smallest reversible route to the objective
phases.exitEvidence: A sequenced plan with explicit verification and rollback points

phases.purpose: Deliver the first runnable vertical slice, then make one bounded improvement at a time
phases.exitEvidence: The primary outcome runs locally before optional polish or exhaustive expansion

phases.purpose: Test behavior and inspect relevant artifacts in the correct environments
phases.exitEvidence: Each required criterion has current evidence

phases.purpose: Classify failures and try one focused repair within the retry budget
phases.exitEvidence: The failure is resolved, replanned, or escalated

phases.purpose: Record results, provenance, uncertainty, and candidate lessons
phases.exitEvidence: Run assessment and learning evidence are committed

operatingRules: Establish a baseline before implementation when an existing behavior or artifact is available
Protect time-to-value: show a verified runnable slice before optional polish, exhaustive content collection, or secondary capabilities
Batch blocking questions and treat non-blocking gaps as recorded assumptions or placeholders
Make at most one focused change per evaluation iteration
Prefer deterministic checks, then supplement with artifact, live, or human evidence when needed
Never weaken tests, security controls, acceptance criteria, or evidence labels to obtain a pass
Do not claim an environment was verified unless evidence was collected in that environment
Stop and request approval before changing architecture, license posture, sensitive-data boundaries, destructive behavior, or global tooling policy
